standard_prerequisites.name: The motive of the projective line with its degree two cycle is the inverse twist of the unit
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, the lemma identifying the motive of the projective line with the zero cycle with the unit and the motive with the degree two cycle with the unit twisted by minus one
standard_prerequisites.use: Replaces negative twists of the unit by tensor powers of the motive of the projective line.

standard_prerequisites.name: Description of the tensor product of motives and of direct sums
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: The construction of the tensor structure on motives through the product of the underlying schemes, and the description of direct sums of motives through disjoint unions
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the tensor powers appearing in the reduction with the motive of a product, reducing to the case of equal twists.

core_obligations: Equal twists (proof lines 1051-1054): for two motives with the same twist a direct sum is given by the disjoint union of the underlying schemes with the sum of the projections, with the evident notation.

Reduce the general case (proof lines 1056-1071): if one twist is smaller, the corresponding motive is the tensor product of the motive with the larger twist by the appropriate number of copies of the unit twisted by minus one; replacing those by the motive of the projective line with its degree two cycle turns the motive into the motive of a product of the scheme with powers of the projective line at the larger twist, which reduces the statement to the case of equal twists.
proof_roadmap: Give the direct sum for equal twists by a disjoint union.
Replace the negative twists by tensor powers of the projective line motive.
Rewrite as a motive of a product and reduce to the first case.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that the category of motives is additive (statement lines 1046-1048). The proof (proof lines 1049-1071) constructs direct sums by disjoint unions when the twists agree and reduces the general case using the identification of the twisted projective line motive with an inverse twist of the unit. H2: a complete short argument.
